title: Harrd Core Sister phonk-funk bounce x Harrd Core Sisters (Mashup)
style: phonk-funk rave, bilingual EN PT hooks, 128 BPM, female lead vocals, male rap hype, layered group chants, call-and-response hooks, double-time rap verse, punk-rock snarl, airy high hold, vinyl crackle intro, vocal shhhht effects, tight vocal stacking, bass-heavy groove, arena chorus, soft vinyl outro, birthday anthem, emotional peak
lyrics:
[singer A]
Meet me in the signal, meet me in the sound
Sing It Back! I sing it back!
Sing It Back! Soul sista, lay it down!
Sing It Back! I sing it back!
Sing It Back! No distance, just sound!

[singer B]
Happy birthday, my beautiful soul sista
Even though we’re miles and miles apart
I still feel you right here in my heart
Your support lifts me every single day
Your love stretches farther than words can say
You are appreciated, sis — now it’s time for you

[melodic interlude]

[singer A]
I don’t want your keyboard heart, no paragraphs on the screen
Everybody posts love but the voice says what it means
I slid through the waveform, low lights, sister attack
You dropped two real words and I felt that
No comment section, no reply chain, no distance war
This ain’t a chat, this a frequency — open up the door

[singer B]
Through every karaoke night we sang till dawn
Through every pickleball win you charged on strong
You move like a bull — fierce, unstoppable, free
But your heart stays soft and safe for me

[transition]

[singer A]
Alegria não é acidente
É o amor de irmã que escolhe a gente
Se tua alma sente o som
Já ganhou sem competição

[singer B]
Happy birthday, my beautiful soul sista!
May you thrive in peace of mind and heart
Release the bulls of joy on your special day
Love that never fades, never goes away

[singer A]
Sing It Back! I sing it back!
Sing It Back! We own the track!
We flip the whole world up and never let it stop
Sing it back, 100 percent
From my chest straight to your content
Alegria em cada beat que eu mando
Hardcore sister love — that’s the brand!

[singer B]
Thank you, sis, for always showing up for me
Your words wrap around me like family
I play my pickleball, I swing and I fight
But your air hugs heal everything right
Our bond is forever — it can never go wrong
You know my heart, you send your light
Unconditional love, day and night

[instrumental]

[singer A]
You want it clear? Here it is.
Don’t type to me. Sing to me.
Sing it back, from your chest to the sky
On your birthday, sis — let the whole world hear why
We are the real sisters… the ones who sing awake…
Unconditional love… no matter the miles we take…
Happy birthday, beautiful soul sista… thrive in peace of mind and heart…

[singer B]
Even when we’re not close geographically
Your love still reaches and wraps around me
Like the bull you are on the court so strong
Today we release the love bulls — all day long!

[singer A]
Sing It Back! I sing it back!
Sing It Back! We own the track!
No comments for the empty miles, only songs that make us brave
Sing it back, 100 percent
Night-ride glow on every continent
Alegria em cada beat que eu mando
If you mean it — put that hardcore sister love in the song!

[singer B]
Happy birthday, my beautiful soul sista…
May you thrive in peace of mind and heart…
I feel your love… always… always…
